name: Progressive Rock (5/4)
description: A three-section progressive rock concept suite in 5/4, built around a rolling ostinato and an instrumental duel.

defaults.concept: Progressive rock concept suite in 5/4 — intricate tom-driven rhythms, long-form narrative verses, and a virtuosic instrumental duel anchored by a heavy backbeat on beat 4.

slots.label: The Rolling Ostinato
slots.purpose: FEEL: Urgent, cyclical, spinning forward. PRODUCTION NOTE: Keyboards establish a rolling 5/4 ostinato. The drum MIDI clip utilizes intricate tom-tom accent lines on beats 1, 3, and 4 instead of a standard hi-hat tick.

slots.label: The Linear Verse
slots.purpose: FEEL: Narrative story bed. TRICK: Vocal melodies stretch out over long phrases that cross over the 5-beat boundaries. In the final 2 bars of the verse, completely drop out the low end of the mix to clear a dynamic valley.

slots.label: The Instrumental Duel
slots.purpose: FEEL: Virtuosic and highly theatrical. TRICK: A blazing trade-off solo layout alternating phrases between leads. The drum clip locks a heavy, unchanging snare backbeat straight on beat 4 of every measure to anchor the odd time signature.
